hypothesis: H1 poorest spend less on communication
evidence: Q5/Q1 median spend 2.1x; income elasticity 0.01 (<1 = poor spend a larger SHARE of income)

hypothesis: H2 rural households face higher digital barrier
evidence: adjusted OR no home internet, rural vs urban = 1.28 [1.23; 1.34]

hypothesis: H3 transfer recipients borrow more for current needs

evidence: 45% of recipients service debt; capped offset = 33.7% of transfer money (weak test: repayment vs transfer, same year)

hypothesis: H5 low income + dependency + no connectivity overlap
evidence: double-vulnerable 4.7%; co-occurrence ratio vs independence 0.99; invisibility zone 6.3% (2024)

hypothesis: H6 SMS / zero-rating can reach the vulnerable
evidence: 79% of double-vulnerable households have mobile coverage (scenario estimate, not a causal test)
